correctness.rationale: Step 1 gives a PL homeomorphism of the actual fixed set and a precisely verified orbit adjacency rule. Steps 2–3 use a good simplicial cover and explicit free edge–triangle nerve collapses to show the core is \(K_{q,q}\), and identify all remaining maximal triangles and their attaching edges. Their boundaries realize all standard bipartite square relations, including a fundamental-group normal generating family, so the resulting two-dimensional CW homotopy model is simply connected. Euler characteristic is 1+\((q-1)^2(q^2-2)/2\), and Hurewicz/Whitehead give a wedge of exactly that many \(S^2\) with integral homology. Component inclusions establish every barcode. The packaged finite checker reconstructs orbit distances and mod-two boundary ranks for \(q=2,3,4\) and agrees, but is not the all-q proof.

value.rationale: A canonical involution on the q-ary 3-cube at the topologically central scale two produces an infinite family of actual geometric fixed spaces, with integral homotopy spheres and an exact quartic sphere count. The result solves the full fixed-space persistent homology across all four Hamming regimes and contrasts sharply with the known 46 ambient \(S^3\) classes in the ternary case. This is a motivated natural invariant of a highly symmetric metric-complex family; it is not just an isolated numerical computation.
